verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਉ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਡਾਰੀਅਤ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਖੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਤਊ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise tau asaT dhaat ddaareeat naau bikhai paar parai taeh tuoo vaar paar soiee hai ||

en.bdb: As a bundle of eight metals loaded in a boat will reach the other bank without any change in its form or colour during transit,

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਧਾਤੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਮੈ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਰੂਪ ਤਊ ਜੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪੈ ਸੁ ਘਾਟ ਠਾਟ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: soiee dhaat agan mai hot hai agan roop tuoo joiee soiee pai su ghaaT ThaaT hoiee hai ||

en.bdb: When these metals are put in fire, they melt and acquire the form of fire. It is then turned into beautiful ornaments of metal better looking than each individually.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਪੁਨਿ ਕੰਚਨ ਹੁਇ ਮੋਲ ਕੈ ਅਮੋਲਾਨੂਪ ਰੂਪ ਅਵਲੋਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: soiee dhaat paaras paras pun ka(n)chan hui mol kai amolaanoop roop avaloiee hai ||

en.bdb: But when it comes in contact with philosopher-stone, it turns into gold. Beside becoming invaluable, it also becomes beautiful and attractive to look at.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਹੋਤ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਸਤਸੰਗ ਪੋਈ ਹੈ ॥੧੬੬॥
verses.translit_en: param paaras gur paras paaras hot sa(n)gat hui saadh sa(n)g satasa(n)g poiee hai ||166||

en.bdb: Similarly in the company of God-oriented and holy men, one becomes holy. Meeting with True Guru, the Supreme of all philosopher-stones, one becomes like a philosopher-stone. (166)
